Residenca Scanderbeg eshte nje objekt unik banimi dhe sherbimesh 9 dhe 13 kate mbi toke me 1 kat sherbimi nentoke dhe 3 kate parkimi nentoke. Ndodhet ne zonen me ideale per jetese dhe zhvillim biznesi. Scanderbeg Residence ndodhet vetem pak minuta larg qendres dhe me akses te pakrahasueshem me te gjitha institucionet qendrore e vendore te kryeqytetit.

 • Lartesia 3.50 m2
.• Orientim lindje.

.• Ambiente te perbashketa te mire organizuara dhe te gjelberuara..

description_en: We have studios for sale located in the Center of Tirana, Scanderbeg Residence. Information about the residence: Multifunctional building located in the heart of the capital, which offers elegant apartments, comfortable offices and modern commercial premises. The Scanderbeg Residence is a unique residential and service facility 9 and 13 floors above ground with 1 underground service floor and 3 underground parking floors. It is located in the most ideal area for living and business development. Scanderbeg Residence is located just a few minutes away from the center and with incomparable access to all central and local institutions of the capital. Information about the apartment: • Surface of the apartment: 50 m2. • 11th floor. • Height 3.50 m2. • East orientation. • Free and panoramic view. • Buildings with high design and construction standards. • The facility consists of 4 underground floors. • Ventilated facade. • Structural coating with thermal insulation layer and HT (high teak) ceramic tiles. • The windows have thermal glass with aluminum case. • Triplex glass with argon gas filling that enables thermal and acoustic insulation, shutters with acoustic membranes. • Chiller system. • Well organized and green common areas.. • Very good investment opportunity. To visit it, contact us!
